subject: Function-address-identifier
notes: 'For a COBOL function, the address is that of the function identified by the externalized function-name in its FUNCTION-ID paragraph' - this implementation's function-pointer representation IS that name (ProgramTable.Node.CallName, the 11.5.4 GR1 AS literal when one is written and the declared word otherwise, kb/Work PB303), so the rule is satisfied by construction rather than by a conversion. 'For a non-COBOL function, the relation between the address and the associated function is defined by the implementor' - this implementation declares support for no non-COBOL function, which is published under A.1 item 210 (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7 DOC-A.1-210, the allowable-languages half); such a function has no run-unit registration, so GR4 - EC-FUNCTION-NOT-FOUND and the predefined address NULL - is the defined answer for one.
